# Volume II: Mechanical Infrastructure and Thermal Management Systems Measurement

This volume details technical takeoff methodologies and cost drivers for central chilled water plants, primary heat rejection, white space air handling and aisle containment, and high-density Direct-to-Chip (DTC) and immersion liquid cooling Technology Cooling Systems (TCS).
